stem: Which sentence best describes the difference in tone between the two quotations?

options.label: F
options.text: The tone of the first quotation is elevated and lofty, while the tone of the second quotation is modest and casual.

options.label: G
options.text: The tone of the first quotation is strident and shrill, while the tone of the second quotation is soft and understated.

options.label: H
options.text: The tone of the first quotation is cynical and pessimistic, while the tone of the second quotation is bright and idealistic.

options.label: J
options.text: The tone of the first quotation is disapproving and moralistic, while the tone of the second quotation is open-minded and tolerant.

visual_elements: Creative Solutions to Life's Challenges: I believe that the highest quality of life is full of art and creative expression and that all people deserve it.
Back Home: After supper sometimes we'd walk out to a neighbor's house, or else we'd just sit and talk or play the hand-cranked Victrola.
